chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Supererogatory worship cannot bring about nearness to Allāh if it hampers the obligatory.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for supererogatory worship to be accepted?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes a hierarchical principle in worship, asserting that supererogatory acts (nawafil) are void of spiritual proximity if they detract from the proper fulfillment of obligatory duties (fara'id). This maxim, central to Shia jurisprudence, warns against the common pitfall of prioritizing visible optional devotions while neglecting the foundational pillars of Islam. It underscores that the integrity of the obligatory act takes precedence over the quantity of voluntary ones.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 39. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace he upon him, said:
Supererogatory worship cannot bring about nearness to Allāh if it hampers the obligatory.
